title: Defensive two-point returns (experimental)
summary: Enable defensive try returns, split history, original-team kickoff, try safeties and CPU return selection. Adds a native box-score row, player-card column, player points, event labels and a saved player season/career category, including completed franchise games. EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED.

gui.reason: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. All presets leave this off. Manual witness-disc selection after protected integration. Suspended saves do not retain the new current-game counts.

input_constraints: User-owned USA NFL 2K5 executable in a disposable disc image; pinned instructions and recognized section geometry.
Allocate the complete owner union before growth. Changing owners requires rebuilding from base.

Completed-game player history uses native packed field 59; regular season and postseason remain separate. Current-game counts are not serialized in suspended saves. Archived per-game franchise box scores are not extended.
Live counts and each saved season saturate at 32767. Team historical totals follow current roster membership. Existing offensive conversion fields and saved TEAM field 87 are preserved.
portme: Complete protected integration and regenerate the production cave manifest as specified in WIRING.md.
Complete every Noah witness in ASTRA_DEFENSIVE_TRY_BOXSCORE_REPORT.md. Suspended-game counts and archived per-game franchise box scores need separate format work.

public_distribution.rule: Distribute source and recipes, never a generated retail executable or disc.

runtime.scope: Static and bounded Unicorn proofs of committed history, stat/attempt readers, native box formatting, player-card callbacks, season merge, fold/delete and roster save/load relocation. Actual loader, visible rendering, commentary, CPU pursuit, penalties and period/OT behavior remain unwitnessed.
